title: Progress Monitoring from Drone Imagery

blueprintSignals.name: Point cloud registration
blueprintSignals.definition: root-mean-square error of aligned points to BIM control points
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Drift over a large site needs control markers

blueprintSignals.name: Element completion
blueprintSignals.definition: classifier probability that an element is built, per element
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Occlusion hides elements, so report visibility alongside

blueprintSignals.name: Deviation
blueprintSignals.definition: millimetres between the as-built surface and the BIM surface per element
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Noise in the point cloud limits precision, so state the error margin

blueprintSignals.name: Schedule variance
blueprintSignals.definition: planned finish minus predicted finish by task, in days

engineFeatures.meaning: how strongly a region stands out from its neighbourhood
the strongest local contrast anywhere in the image
contrast divided by the image's own noise level
which scanner or camera produced the image
augmentation that stops the model using overall brightness

label: For "Progress Monitoring from Drone Imagery": Compare drone captures to the BIM or schedule to estimate progress by element and flag deviations. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on one site hides failures on sites with different structures and materials.
